label: start pipeline producer before embedding dispatch
hypothesis: Launch pipeline gather/prefetch before submitting the embedding kernel, so first-layer CPU lookup/H2D can overlap embedding startup instead of depending on an entry event recorded after embedding.
expected_bottleneck: Frozen A0001 startup diagnostic records embedding CUDA intervals0.041856/0.112032 ms at b1/b8; current model enqueues embedding before pipeline forward records its entry dependency and submits producer. These intervals may include dispatch gaps and cannot be claimed as removable latency.
change: Defer only pipeline embedding to the first layer consumer, after producer submission and entry recording. Preserve bulk ordering, supplied-hidden-state semantics, embedding values and all layer arithmetic.
tradeoffs: Earlier transfer can contend with embedding bandwidth; producer setup delays embedding submission.
All hidden-state and KV outputs must remain bit-exact; deferred initialization and exception paths need explicit tests.
arithmetic_contract: Scheduling-only, zero absolute/relative error against folded resident reference.
primary_target: b1/b8 prefill; bulk decode cannot nominate gain

not_run.confirmation: Not run: changed primary screens unpromising.
not_run.full_model_correctness: Not run: small-model exactness passed; candidate not nominated.

draft_condition: Activated from A0016 after A0018 screening rejection and code-only reversion. Original model delta applied; new tests appended without removing A0016 tests. A0018 was not retained.
draft_validation: Syntax compile only; runtime exactness and producer cancellation not yet tested.
eligible_gain_note: Structured representation of the primary target already declared at registration; unchanged scope.
decision: Rejected at screening: both changed prefill primary paths have higher offload latency versus A0016 (b1+0.042619 ms, b8+0.366468 ms). b8 gap worsens0.106847 ms; b1 apparent gap reduction0.024187 ms is explained by a slower resident reference and cannot qualify. Unchanged b1 bulk decode reduction0.377981 ms cannot nominate this pipeline-only change.
limitations: Short screen only; adverse observations are not independent resolved regression estimates.
Earlier producer submission may contend with embedding; this screen does not establish a mechanism.
